review_locator: PMCID:PMC5425962, Structural aspects of nucleic acid-sensing Toll-like receptors
primary_title: Sequence specific detection of bacterial 23S ribosomal RNA by TLR13; Structural basis for specific recognition of single-stranded RNA by Toll-like receptor 13
decision_basis: Sequence- and conformation-specific 23S rRNA-derived ssRNA recognition by mouse TLR13 is supported by structural, mutational and Tlr13-dependent cytokine evidence
limitations_preserved: Preserve the 13-nt sequence/stem-loop ligand, mouse-only TLR13 context and 2:2 dimerization; no intact-ribosome or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Crystal structure of the TLR1-TLR2 heterodimer induced by binding of a tri-acylated lipopeptide
decision_basis: Pam3CSK4 occupies complementary TLR2 and TLR1 pockets and induces the defined ectodomain heterodimer
limitations_preserved: Preserve triacylated Pam3CSK4 and soluble ectodomain assembly scope; no native-lipoprotein equivalence, universal signaling or terminal-TF inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC3075535, The Structural Biology of Toll-Like Receptors
primary_title: Recognition of lipopeptide patterns by Toll-like receptor 2-Toll-like receptor 6 heterodimer
decision_basis: Pam2CSK4 is structurally recognized by the defined mouse TLR2:TLR6 ectodomain heterodimer
